data.content:
Fluminense and Palmeiras begin their battle for a place in the 2026 Copa Libertadores final when they meet in the first leg of their all-Brazilian semi-final at the Maracana on Wednesday night.

The hosts are looking to make home advantage count after resting several key players in Sunday's 1-0 defeat to Flamengo, while the visitors arrive in a confident mood after thrashing Corinthians 4-1 in the Paulista derby.

## Match preview [...] The Maracana should give Fluminense an important platform, having progressed to the semifinals by eliminating Platense, winning the first leg 2-0 at home before losing 2-1 in Argentina to advance 3-2 on aggregate.
